newsitem.title: USA: Palomar says court grants suer's motion.
newsitem.headline: Palomar says court grants suer's motion.

text.p: Palomar Medical Technologies Inc said Friday a federal court in New York granted a motion by Commonwealth Associates for partial summary judgment regarding Commonwealth's lawsuit against it.
Palomar said the judgment involves the issue of liability in Commonwealth's breach of contract complaint.

Palomor said that, in the lawsuit, Commonwealth alleges breach of a contract in which Commonwealth would serve as Palomar's financial advisor in connection with possible merger and acquisition transactions.
No acquisitions were completed under the contract, Palomar said.
Commonweath Associates has alleged it suffered up to $2.7 million in damages.

Palomar, which supplies proprietary laser systems for skin and cosmetic laser treatment, said it will vigorously contest at trial the amount of damages sought and will appeal, if necessary, the court's grant of partial summary judgment.
